scope: blind exact-row input, output and pair verification

reviews.critique: The input is a natural, self-contained request. The output appropriately organizes it as a prompt without answering it, preserving both requested checks, the code-only constraint, and the SQL verbatim, including the status filter, units > 31 threshold, SUM alias, and depot_id grouping.

The input is a plausible informal request with clear conditional instructions. The output organizes it into a natural, self-contained prompt without performing the task. It preserves the small lighting crew, quick setup checklist, and both branches of the side aisle work light condition, including notifying the stage manager if it is not working.

The input is a coherent procedural draft with recoverable intent and no material contradictions or extraneous authoring instructions. The output provides plain, readable polish throughout without material omissions or additions. It preserves the archive’s scope and history, intake-number examples, copying and device-handling conditions, required card checks, restrictions on listening access, correction procedures, and separate storage arrangements. Permissions, prohibitions, uncertainty, and supplied literals remain intact.

The input is a natural, self-contained request with no contradictions or authoring artifacts. The output clearly organizes the request without answering it, preserves both explanation and issue-review tasks and the SQL-only constraint, and reproduces the SQL unchanged, including the status filter, units > 9 condition, aggregation, alias, and grouping.

The input is a natural, self-contained request. The output is byte-identical, as required by the identity flag, and preserves the short-scene format, first evening shift, charity kitchen setting, and focus on soup preparation and welcoming guests without performing the task.

The input is a natural casual message with clear intent. The output makes only capitalization and punctuation fixes, preserving the casual tone, completed sorting and counting, Saturday's exchange, Maya, the timing, the request to bring paper labels to the library table, and the approximate shortage of 20. No material defects.

The input is a coherent, recoverable dictation with no leaked instructions or material contradictions. Across all paragraphs, the output preserves the wording, quantities, names, negations, unresolved cargo-bike location, and moisture-line conditions. Changes are limited to appropriate transcription cleanup: capitalization, punctuation, hyphenation, quotation formatting, and rendering the spoken numbered cues as a list. KiteLedger and the meaningful opening “Well” are retained. No material defect found.

The input is a natural, coherent request with recoverable intent and no conflicting constraints. The output appropriately organizes it as a prompt without performing the task. It preserves all 42 folders, the copy start time and dates, access-check recording and reporting, both distinct pass/fail outcomes, the prohibition on switching after a partial pass, IT notification of failed folder names, generic ownership, bookmarked-link uncertainty, and the short-runbook and announcement-preparation constraints. The language and formatting are clear and appropriate.

The input is a natural, self-contained request with consistent watering and staffing requirements. The output appropriately organizes it into a prompt without creating the rota. It preserves the location, dates, bed contents, exact amounts and timing, named volunteers and availability, daily single-person coverage, and numbered-checklist requirements. The instruction to use only the supplied availabilities and information preserves the absence of additional staffing rules; repeat assignments remain permitted. No material defect found.

The input is a natural, self-contained request with recoverable intent and consistent installation conditions. The output organizes it into a usable prompt without writing the work note. It preserves the panel dimensions and wording, left-pointing arrow and loop-trail orientation, approximate distance west of the footbridge, requirement to retain the marker location, both conditional installation options, and the instruction not to assume inspection has occurred. Language and formatting are clear and appropriate.

The input is a plausible informal draft with recoverable intent. The output appropriately fixes capitalization, punctuation, and sentence structure for a clear, professional tone. It preserves the people, stalls, location, two crates of basil, invoice handoff, requested delivery this morning, and purpose of checking the count. Replacing “it” with “the invoice” is supported by the context, and the request remains a request rather than an assertion that delivery occurred.

The input is a natural, self-contained drafting request with coherent publication conditions. The output appropriately reorganizes it as a prompt without drafting the correction. It preserves the story title, the 6-1 vote to keep the branch open, Inez Patel’s sole vote to close it, and the prohibitions on speculation and future council actions. It also retains the Thursday print-first condition, the website deadline of noon Friday only if Thursday lacks room, inclusion in the following Thursday’s print edition, and the instruction not to imply publication has already occurred. No material omissions or invented requirements.

The input is a coherent, recoverable German drafting request without contradictory constraints or artificial padding. The output appropriately reorganizes it into a self-contained prompt rather than producing the depot summary. It preserves the SQL verbatim, distinguishes the upstream booking-date restriction from the query’s filters, and retains the strict units > 9 threshold and prohibition on invented totals. All four depot-specific observations and their evidentiary limits remain intact, including Westtor’s unconfirmed duplication and Höhenfeld’s missing delivery_date. The conditional 08:20 correction remains separate from the 06:00 export and is not asserted as confirmed. The numbered-checklist requirement, observation-before-interpretation ordering, brevity constraint, and final physical-inventory disclaimer are also preserved. The German and formatting are natural and appropriate.

The input is natural, coherent prose with recoverable intent. The output is byte-identical, as required by the identity flag, and preserves the notebook attribution, the tentative interpretation of the dark band, and the limitation imposed by weathering. Its plain, direct language fits the supplied profile.

The output correctly applies that correction and otherwise limits changes to capitalization and punctuation. It preserves the literal key sync.limit_uploads, the orchard launch folder name, the folder-only scope, the instruction not to change the global limit or other sync settings, continued syncing of new and existing files, and the distinction between two observed uploads and the requested maximum of four. No material omissions or paraphrasing.

The input is a coherent, self-contained drafting request with consistent source notes and constraints. The output appropriately reorganizes it into a prompt without drafting the correction.
